metadata.description: IndyKite skills for coding agents — Agent Gateway deployment, MCP server calls, KBAC authorization policy authoring and lifecycle, AuthZEN decisions and search (single evaluation, batch evaluations, action / resource / subject search), runtime listing of a project's active KBAC policies, Capture API ingests and deletes (nodes, relationships, properties, property metadata), IKG data-schema reads, ContX IQ policies / Knowledge Queries / executes (read, create node, create relationship, combined create-with-link, add property, add relationship property, delete), and ContX IQ whoami (resolve an end-user token to its IKG subject).
